description:
FILED by the s532 Fable merge review (2026-11-02), probes ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s532/review/merge-review/probes/p-coreamp-3.pl and p-coreamp-2.pl.  REGRESSION: base d47caabe runs these, main b31345ca dies with a raw SBCL undefined-function error (not perl-shaped).  Introduced by s530c member #3859 (commit b5cbdfe1 "&NAME(LIST) asks no prototype -- LIST in list context, spread at the call"; MAIN-READY-57 deb1125d).

    my @b = &CORE::binmode(\*STDOUT);        # perl 1        base 1                        main ERR: pcl:p-binmode is a macro, not a function
    &CORE::push(\@a, 3);                     # perl 3 elems  base (another, pre-existing fail) main ERR: pcl:p-push is a macro, not a function
    &CORE::open(my $fh, "<", $0);            # perl ok       base ok                       main ERR: pcl:p-open is a macro, not a function
    &CORE::lc / &CORE::join / &CORE::length / &CORE::sprintf / &CORE::abs / &CORE::die   -- function heads: fine on both

EMISSION (./pl2cl on main): (p-list-ctx (p-amp-spread (p-binmode (p-backslash (p-make-typeglob "main" "STDOUT"))))).  MECHANISM (Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_funcall_form): the spread is emitted when `$force_user && $user_call`, and `$user_call = ($force_user || !exists $RUNTIME_NAMES{$func_name} ...)` is TRUE for every &-call, a CORE::-qualified builtin included; p-amp-spread expands to (%p-amp-apply (quote HEAD) (list ARGS...)) and (apply (quote p-binmode) ...) cannot apply a macro.

TWO FACTS, so the fix is not "skip macro heads": (1) a runtime op spelled as a MACRO can never be `apply`ed -- the spread must stay a direct form for it; (2) perlsub's "the & form ignores the prototype" does NOT hold for CORE:: subs: pp_coreargs enforces the builtin's arity at call time (`&CORE::ucfirst(1,2)` dies "Too many arguments for CORE::ucfirst", `&CORE::uc()` reads $_), which is exactly what op/coreamp.t tests.

FIX SHAPE: `&CORE::NAME(LIST)` is excluded from #3859's rule at the ONE predicate (Pl::PExpr::call_prototype answers the builtin's prototype for a CORE::-qualified name, and gen_funcall_form emits no p-amp-spread for it) -- the pre-s530c lowering of these calls comes back; the coreargs arity semantics themselves are #1577's family (pre-existing, same probe: &CORE::keys({a=>1,b=>2}) 0 vs perl 2, &CORE::pop(\@a) empty vs 3, &CORE::wantarray undef vs defined).  Belt: p-amp-spread dies at EXPANSION time naming the head when (macro-function HEAD) (rule 12: a missing case dies loudly, never a raw host error at run time).  Guard: Pl/t rows for &CORE::binmode / &CORE::open / &CORE::push through the & form (inverse-checked on deb1125d^).  ir-spec section 4.1 (the & call): "never for a CORE::-qualified name".

COMPANION ATTRIBUTION (for s531d): op/coreamp.t 16 NEW rows (&binmode, &break, the &uc / &ucfirst / &umask / &undef arity + context rows) and 16 FIXED rows in the same run -- one bisect step: t/op/coreamp.t at deb1125d vs 9aa02173.


=== DONE (s532a) ===
FIXED (7ab2bffd): Pl::PExpr marks a `&CORE::NAME(LIST)` call amp_core (not CORE::GLOBAL::); ONE predicate Pl::PExpr::amp_ignores_prototype (force_user_sub and not amp_core) answers for call_prototype and for ExprToCL's p-amp-spread, so every &CORE:: call lowers as the builtin -- emission byte-identical to d47caabe's for the three probes' shapes (p-coreamp-2.pl and -3.pl: tree output == d47caabe output; -1.pl: the no-arg `&CORE::uc()` raw crash is d47caabe's too, #1577's family).  Belt: p-amp-spread refuses a macro head at expansion time naming it (rule 12).  Controls kept: `&f(@two)` / `&f(1,2)` with `sub f($)` pass two; the existing amp-call-proto rows (context, spread) pass.  Guard Pl/t/amp-call-proto-01.t row 1 'core-amp' (perl oracle; FAILS on main's code 10cdc985 -- the bug is ON main, not on d47caabe).  ir-spec (the & call) one normative paragraph.  corpus-diff vs 10cdc985: nothing beyond the batch's other members (no perl-tests file spells &CORE::).
op/coreamp.t one-file companion, REPORTED ONLY (s531d owns the baseline files): main 22 ok / 280 not-ok -> tree 14 / 53 (d47caabe: 10 / 57).  The file now STOPS at row 67: test_proto 'exit' runs `eval " &CORE::exit((1)x2) "`, which EXITS with status 2 where perl dies "Too many arguments for exit" -- the coreargs arity check, #1577's family.  On main the failing apply of the spread happened to raise an error the eval caught, so the file ran on (and 109 of its top-level forms aborted on the macro error; 18 abort now).  So the companion's coreamp.t rows after row 67 are held by #1577 now, as they were on d47caabe.  Probes: scratch/s532a/p/p-coreamp-[123].pl, cx.pl, keep/ + keep-main/ (the kept companion outputs) in the s532a worktree.
subject: REGRESSION (s530c #3859, loud raw SBCL error): `&CORE::NAME(LIST)` is emitted as (p-amp-spread (p-NAME ...)) and %p-amp-apply `apply`s the head -- a runtime MACRO head (p-binmode, p-push, p-open, ...) dies "pcl:p-binmode is a macro, not a function"; base ran them; perl's &CORE::NAME also ENFORCES the builtin's arity, so the prototype-ignoring & rule never applies to CORE:: -- t/op/coreamp.t's 16 NEW rows
